settings.intro_heading: A calmer way to buy garden tools
settings.intro_text:
Gardner is a demonstration garden-tools storefront built around a simple idea: the right tool should be easy to understand, comfortable to use, and worth keeping.

We focus on a deliberate range for digging, planting, pruning and watering — with clear product details and practical guides, so you can spend less time comparing and more time in the garden.
settings.approach_text: Three simple ideas guide the range — and the way we think about useful garden tools.
settings.journal_text: Practical guides for the jobs in front of you.
